description: Attach proof of delivery to a receipt. Requires the edit_token from record_approval. Moves approved to delivered, or to disputed when status is disputed. over_cap is true when actual_amount exceeds the price cap. Does not move money. Same as POST /v1/receipts/:id/proof.

actual_amount.description: Amount actually charged. over_cap is true when this is above the price cap.

edit_token.description: Secret returned once by record_approval. Required to attach proof.

status.description: Omit to mark an approved receipt delivered. Pass disputed to dispute it.

type.description: Proof kind. Examples: order_confirmation, tracking, url, hash.

value.description: The proof itself: confirmation id, tracking number, URL, or hash.

name: attach_proof
title: Attach delivery proof
